visible_observation: The 'Precipitation Intensity' bar chart is positioned directly behind the 'Recommended Actions' text box. The bars are completely obscured by the dark overlay of the text box, and the chart's subtitle ('Shift towards concentrated...') is partially cut off by the box's top edge.
critique: This layout violates the mandate to 'not omit secondary information merely to make the composition cleaner.' By burying the rainfall visualization under the text box, the design renders the data invisible, preventing the reader from understanding the 'concentrated rainfall' aspect of the climate story.
revision: Move the 'Recommended Actions' box to the bottom right corner (below the precipitation chart) or to the right of the temperature chart. This will reveal the rainfall bars and ensure all requested visualizations are fully visible.
protected_strength: The clear, high-contrast headline indicators at the top right and the expressive gradient line chart for temperature trends.
